text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Grass<n>Wonder
learns that both she and<n>Maruzensky are predicted
to earn<n>places in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The prospect of finally facing the<n>Beast in a
decisive showdown looms<n>large in her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just before the race, Grass Wonder<n>runs into El
Condor Pasa. Determined<n>to prove that she is the
more worthy<n>successor to the Beast, she
accompanies her rival to the track.
